newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moevenpick H1 net profit 5.5 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Moevenpick H1 net profit 5.5 million Sfr.

text.p: Swiss restaurant and hotel group Moevenpick AG, reporting half year profits for the first time, said net after taxes in the first six months of 1996 was 5.5 million Swiss francs ($4.4 million).
Moevenpick said operating profit from January through June was 7.2 million Swiss francs.

"Although there are no comparative consolidated figures for the previous year, we can confirm based on internal accounting that the results are clearly above those of last year," Moevenpick said in an interim report.
Moevenpick said sales declined three percent to 537.1 million Swiss francs from 553.7 million Swiss francs in the 1995 period.
It said the reduction was based on divesting restaurants and hotels as well as negative currency influences.
